description.description: Natural language description of the causal question.

unit_definition.description: The unit of analysis (e.g., "code patch", "configuration change").

ComparabilitySnapshot.description: Immutable comparability snapshot for a paired experiment family.

comparable.description: Explicit verdict when known; `None` preserves absence rather than inference.

selected_checks.description: Ordered list of checks run for the pair.

ContentDigest.description: A BLAKE3 content digest with explicit identity context.

ContradictionStatus.description: Contradiction status for claims and relations.

DigestMetadata.description: Identity context cryptographically bound into a content digest.

schema_id.description: Schema identifier for the hashed value.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the hashed value.

EnvironmentFingerprint.description:
Fingerprint of the execution environment.

Used to detect environment drift that could affect reproducibility.

env_hash.description: Hash of the full environment specification (e.g., pip freeze hash).

EstimatorMeta.description:
Metadata about an estimator or refuter invocation.

Captures everything needed to reproduce or audit the estimation.

failure_mode.description: How the estimator failed, if it did.

random_seed.description: Random seed, if applicable for reproducibility.

version.description: Version of the estimator (semver or commit hash).

EvidenceBundle.description:
An evidence bundle capturing the full methodological chain.

This is the minimal but real evidence-bundle substrate required by the canonical verification pipeline. Every field maps to a requirement in the master delta spec.

claim_ids.description: Claim IDs this bundle provides evidence for.

comparability_snapshot.description: Immutable comparability snapshot for the paired family, when known.

estimator_version.description: Estimator version (semantic versioning or commit hash).

identification_rationale.description: Identification rationale (why we believe the causal identification is valid).

raw_receipt_handle.description: Raw receipt handle (opaque reference to the underlying raw data).

refutation_artifacts.description: First-class refutation artifacts with stable identities and lineage.

replay_handle.description: Replay handle (linkage to original execution for replay).

source_envelope_id.description: Source envelope ID if this bundle originated from an export.

trial_id.description: Trial ID for the specific execution.

variance_aware.description: Whether variance-aware repeated trials were used.

verification_summary.description: Compact verification/promotion summary for projection consumers.

EvidenceBundleId.description: Opaque identifier for an evidence bundle.

provider_call_ref.description: Backpointer to the provider call that fulfilled this execution.

replay_parent_ref.description: Backpointer to the replay parent execution context, if this is a retry.

tool_receipt_ref.description: Backpointer to the tool receipt that produced this execution context.

oneOf.description: External authority (e.g., manual import, third-party tool).

assertion_group_id.description: Canonical assertion/hyperedge grouping for claim-version style records.

claim_family_id.description: Canonical claim lineage group when the exporter knows the claim family.

constraint_seed_kind.description: Optional because thin claim exports may group via assertion/family IDs without emitting an explicit kernel seed kind.

derivation_seed_ids.description: Exporter-supplied lineage only. Bridge/runtime/kernel must not invent it.

relation_group_id.description: Canonical relation grouping for relation-version style records.

ForgeExportMeta.description: Metadata about a Forge export operation.

comparability_snapshot_version.description: Comparability snapshot version at time of export.

direct_write.description: Whether direct-write was used (exceptional, auditable, disabled by default).

ImportProjectionRecord.description: A single record in a projection import batch.

oneOf.description: A claim projection version to import.

claim_state.description: Current state of this claim version.

preferred_open.description: Whether this is the preferred open version for its logical key.

subject_entity_id.description: The entity this claim is about.

supersedes_claim_version_id.description: Which previous version this supersedes, if any.

is_human_confirmed_final.description: Whether this is final (only set by human review or audited migration).

superseded_by_entity_id.description: If this entity was superseded by a merge.

ImportProjectionRecordV3.description: A single import record enriched with export-time semantics for kernel compilation.

MergeDecision.description: Merge decision provenance for entity aliases.

outcome_type.description: Whether outcome is binary, continuous, ordinal, etc.

ProjectionFreshness.description:
Projection freshness status.

Extended from the original enum per spec requirements.

oneOf.description: Projection was recently imported and is current.
Projection exists but is older than the staleness threshold.
A newer version has superseded this projection's data.
No import has ever been recorded.
Import is lagging behind the source.

PromotionState.description: Promotion state for the claim represented by this bundle.

RefutationArtifactRecord.description: First-class refutation artifact preserved in canonical raw truth.

attempt_id.description: Attempt that emitted the artifact, when available.

estimate_delta.description: Effect delta / estimate change when available.

trial_id.description: Trial that emitted the artifact, when available.

RefutationAttempt.description: A refutation attempt and its result.

oneOf.description: Refutation did not invalidate the original estimate.

estimate_change.description: How much the estimate changed under the refutation test.

reason.description: Description of how/why the refutation succeeded.

oneOf.description: Refutation was not attempted (e.g., not applicable).

ReviewState.description:
Durable review state for alias/merge decisions.

Must survive restart and be queryable (MASTER_SUPPORTING_DELTA §5.4).

ScopeKey.description:
Compact, hashable representation of all scope dimensions.

This is the canonical partition key for the stack. Two `ScopeKey`s are equal iff all four fields match exactly.

## Display format

`namespace[/domain][@workspace_id][#repo_id]`

Examples: - `prod` — namespace only - `prod/code` — with domain - `prod/code@ws1#myrepo` — fully specified

TraceCtx.description:
In-process trace context for cross-crate correlation.

Wraps a W3C-compatible trace ID and optional parent span ID. Additional bounded baggage can be attached for cross-boundary metadata.

baggage.description: Bounded baggage for cross-boundary metadata. Keys and values must be short ASCII strings. No sensitive data.

parent_id.description: Optional parent span ID (W3C: 16 hex chars).

trace_id.description: The trace ID (W3C: 32 hex chars, or any opaque string for legacy compat).

paired_trials.description: Whether paired baseline-vs-patched trials were used.

VerificationLifecycleState.description: Compact lifecycle state that can be projected into memory-visible truth.

VerificationSummary.description: Compact verification summary designed for projection/import visibility.

comparability_snapshot_version.description: Immutable comparability snapshot version when carried by the source.

completed_trial_count.description: Number of completed trials contributing to the summary.

VerificationTrialRecord.description: First-class verification trial record preserved in canonical raw truth.

receipt_handles.description: Opaque receipt handles tied to this trial.

side.description: Which side of the paired family this trial belongs to.

VerificationTrialSide.description: Baseline-vs-patched side for a verification trial.
